findings.highlight: I develop the strongest weapon I have projected.
findings.evidenceJa: 最硬の物を前面に展開した
findings.governingReading: I deploy the hardest of the objects I have copied in front of me
findings.explanation: A defensive deployment of an existing hardest copy becomes development of the generically strongest weapon.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka’s magical energy disperses without a place to go
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂から貰った魔力は行き場をなくして戻っていく
findings.governingReading: the mana received from Tohsaka loses its pathways and flows back
findings.explanation: Mana returning after Shirou’s circuits disconnect is changed into dissipation.

findings.highlight: I curse myself for never thinking twice.
findings.evidenceJa: 今まで一度も思わなかった事を、心の底から罵倒した
findings.governingReading: from the bottom of my heart, I curse something I had never once resented before
findings.explanation: A first-ever curse against his own limitations becomes self-reproach for habitual thoughtlessness.

findings.highlight: Why is this all the magical energy I have?
findings.evidenceJa: なぜ、俺の回路はこれだけなのか
findings.governingReading: why do I have only this many circuits?
findings.explanation: Shirou’s shortage of Magic Circuits is changed into insufficient mana, confusing capacity with supply.

findings.highlight: I fly through the air and crash to the ground with great force.
findings.evidenceJa: 何十メートルと吹き飛んで、背中から地面に落ちた
findings.governingReading: I am hurled dozens of meters and land on my back
findings.explanation: The distance and back-first landing of Ea’s impact disappear.

findings.highlight: My lungs do not move, rendering me unable to breathe.
findings.evidenceJa: 呼吸をする為の気管は、そのどれもが固まっていた
findings.governingReading: his lungs do not move, and every airway needed to breathe has stiffened
findings.explanation: The distinct paralysis of Shirou’s airways is omitted.

findings.highlight: It would have been more fun if I let Archer live.
findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーが残った方が楽しめた
findings.governingReading: it would have been more entertaining had Archer remained
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s comparison with Archer becomes a claim that he personally spared and later allowed Archer to die.

findings.highlight: I need to regain my consciousness.
findings.evidenceJa: 意識を取り戻して立て
findings.governingReading: regain consciousness and stand
findings.explanation: The deep self’s command to physically rise is omitted.

findings.highlight: A superhero
findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方
findings.governingReading: an ally of justice
findings.explanation: The work’s defining ethical ideal is again replaced by a modern genre label.

findings.highlight: ‘Peace’ is a myth
findings.evidenceJa: 平等という綺麗事
findings.governingReading: the pretty fiction called equality
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s attack on equality is changed into an attack on peace.

findings.highlight: Humans cannot live without sacrifices.
findings.evidenceJa: 人間とは犠牲がなくては生を謳歌できぬ獣の名だ
findings.governingReading: “human” is the name of a beast unable to revel in life without sacrifice
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s bestial definition and the idea of enjoying life through sacrifice are softened.

findings.highlight: like I did on that day
findings.evidenceJa: あの日の、灰色の空と同じだった
findings.governingReading: was the same as the gray sky on that day
findings.explanation: The raised arm’s visual rhyme with the fire’s gray sky disappears.

findings.highlight: It seems like everyone in this world is laughing.
findings.evidenceJa: 耳を覆う高笑いは、世界中の人間の、笑い声のようでもあった
findings.governingReading: the earsplitting peal of laughter seems like the laughter of every person in the world
findings.explanation: The deafening quality and simile become a flat impression that everyone is laughing.

findings.highlight: My wishes are all borrowed.
findings.evidenceJa: この思いは借り物
findings.governingReading: this feeling or conviction is borrowed
findings.explanation: One inherited conviction becomes all of Shirou’s wishes.

findings.highlight: obsession with helping others
findings.evidenceJa: この身は誰かの為にならなければならない
findings.governingReading: the compulsion that this existence must be for someone else’s sake
findings.explanation: Shirou’s existential obligation to justify himself through others is softened to helping behavior.

findings.highlight: Such an imitation cannot save anything.
findings.evidenceJa: そんな偽善は結局何も救えない
findings.governingReading: such hypocrisy ultimately saves nothing
findings.explanation: The ethical accusation of hypocrisy becomes a claim about copied form.

findings.highlight: Everyone died
findings.evidenceJa: 誰もが平等に死んで
findings.governingReading: everyone dies equally
findings.explanation: A general conclusion Shirou formed from the fire becomes a single completed event.

findings.highlight: unless I gave up, saying that humans are weak
findings.evidenceJa: 人間なんてそんなものだと諦めるしか
findings.governingReading: unless I resigned myself to human beings simply being that way
findings.explanation: The English invents weakness as the content of Shirou’s resignation.

findings.highlight: I don’t think such words are right
findings.evidenceJa: そんな悟ったような諦めが、正しいとは思えない
findings.governingReading: I cannot believe that such supposedly enlightened resignation is right
findings.explanation: Shirou rejects a posture of worldly resignation, not merely particular words.

findings.highlight: they are all a fake
findings.evidenceJa: その正体が偽善だ
findings.governingReading: its true nature is hypocrisy
findings.explanation: Archer’s diagnosis of Shirou’s belief becomes a vague assertion that multiple things are fake.

findings.highlight: I make up my mind on this hill of swords.
findings.evidenceJa: 剣の丘で独り思った
findings.governingReading: alone on the hill of swords, he once thought
findings.explanation: A recalled solitary resolution is changed into a present decision.

findings.highlight: Even if
findings.evidenceJa: 磨耗しきる長い年月
findings.governingReading: through the long years in which he is worn completely away
findings.explanation: The lifetime cost between sustaining the dream and finding nothing at its end disappears.

findings.highlight: I was reluctant to use that sword
findings.evidenceJa: 出し惜しんだとは言え
findings.governingReading: though I held back its force
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s admission that he reduced Ea’s output becomes reluctance to use the weapon at all.

findings.highlight: how fast I can get it working
findings.evidenceJa: どれだけ速く自身に働きかけられるか
findings.governingReading: how quickly I can make it act upon myself
findings.explanation: The fact that the incantation must operate on Shirou’s own being disappears.

findings.highlight: allowed to fight against it
findings.evidenceJa: エアと打ち合う権利
findings.governingReading: the right to clash blades with Ea
findings.explanation: The specific privilege of meeting Ea weapon-to-weapon is generalized.

findings.highlight: I managed to survive the previous attack
findings.evidenceJa: あの一撃から奇蹟の生還を遂げた
findings.governingReading: he achieved a miraculous return from that blow
findings.explanation: Shirou’s survival is stripped of its acknowledged impossibility.

findings.highlight: your copying brain
findings.evidenceJa: 偽物を造るその頭蓋
findings.governingReading: that skull which manufactures counterfeits
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s threat to pulverize Shirou’s head becomes awkward pseudo-anatomical phrasing.

findings.highlight: I’ll probably be able to beat him.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺は、きっとあいつに勝てる
findings.governingReading: I will surely be able to beat him
findings.explanation: Shirou’s deliberate assurance to Saber becomes uncertain probability.

findings.highlight: She closes her eyes once.
findings.evidenceJa: 実際は一秒もなかっただろう
findings.governingReading: after less than a second of decision, she closes her eyes deeply once
findings.explanation: The timing estimate is moved after Saber’s decisive gesture.

findings.highlight: I say it in place of the one who cared for her.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が彼女と過ごした時間、ヤツが彼女を思っていた時間を、せめて代弁できるように
findings.governingReading: to speak for both the time I spent with her and the time he spent thinking of her
findings.explanation: The line jointly voices Shirou’s relationship and Archer’s memory, but the English reduces it to an unnamed singular person.

findings.highlight: I couldn’t even figure out your true desire.
findings.evidenceJa: おまえの本当の望みを、見つけてやる事さえ出来なかった
findings.governingReading: I could not even find your true desire for you
findings.explanation: Shirou’s regret over failing to help Saber find her wish becomes an intellectual failure to identify it.

findings.highlight: We shall talk afterwards.
findings.evidenceJa: 伝えたい事は、その後に
findings.governingReading: what I want to tell you will come after that
findings.explanation: Saber’s promise of a specific message is generalized into mutual conversation.

findings.highlight: My magic isn’t creating swords.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の剣製っていうのは、剣を作る事じゃない
findings.governingReading: my sword-forging is not the act of making swords
findings.explanation: The insight distinguishing his sword-forging system from manufacturing swords is generalized to all his magic.

findings.highlight: I am the bone of my sword.
findings.evidenceJa: I am the bone of my sword.
findings.governingReading: my body is made of swords
findings.explanation: mirror moon preserves only the English incantation surface and deletes the active Japanese ruby proposition about Shirou’s body.

findings.highlight: These words are to connect Emiya Shirou.
findings.evidenceJa: 当然のように在った、衛宮士郎を繋げるモノ
findings.governingReading: these words connect the Emiya Shirou who existed as naturally as a matter of course
findings.explanation: The incantation’s continuity with Shirou’s always-present self is omitted.

findings.highlight: each petal of the shield is pierced and damaged
findings.evidenceJa: 七枚羽の盾がひび割れ、砕かれるたび
findings.governingReading: each time a petal of the seven-winged shield cracks and shatters
findings.explanation: Catastrophic shield breakage is softened to piercing and damage.

findings.highlight: Steel is my body
findings.evidenceJa: Steel is my body, and fire is
findings.governingReading: my blood is iron
findings.explanation: The active Japanese ruby proposition about iron blood is replaced by steel body.

findings.highlight: fire is my blood
findings.evidenceJa: Steel is my body, and fire is
findings.governingReading: my heart is glass
findings.explanation: The active Japanese ruby proposition about a glass heart is replaced by fire blood.

findings.highlight: the magical energy in front of him
findings.evidenceJa: 目前に奔る魔力の流れ
findings.governingReading: the flow of mana racing before him
findings.explanation: The dynamic surge that startles Gilgamesh becomes static energy.

findings.highlight: I have created over a thousand blades.
findings.evidenceJa: I have created over a thousand blades.
findings.governingReading: having crossed countless battlefields
findings.explanation: The active Japanese ruby proposition about repeated battlefields is replaced by a weapon count.

findings.highlight: Unaware of loss.
findings.evidenceJa: I have created over a thousand blades.
findings.governingReading: without even one retreat in defeat
findings.explanation: A concrete absence of battlefield rout becomes vague unawareness of loss.

findings.highlight: Nor aware of gain.
findings.evidenceJa: I have created over a thousand blades.
findings.governingReading: without even one victory
findings.explanation: The paradox that Shirou never won becomes lack of awareness of gain.

findings.highlight: Blood trickles from my mouth.
findings.evidenceJa: 血が逆流する
findings.governingReading: blood flows backward
findings.explanation: Internal reverse flow becomes a mild outward trickle.

findings.highlight: my body is full of holes
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎の体は欠けている
findings.governingReading: parts of Emiya Shirou’s body are missing
findings.explanation: Damage transmitted through the shield is changed from bodily loss to perforation.

findings.highlight: Withstood pain to create weapons.
findings.evidenceJa: With stood pain to create weapons.
findings.governingReading: the bearer stands here alone
findings.explanation: The active Japanese ruby proposition about the solitary bearer is replaced by enduring pain to make weapons.

findings.highlight: Waiting for one’s arrival.
findings.evidenceJa: With stood pain to create weapons.
findings.governingReading: forging iron upon the hill of swords
findings.explanation: The active Japanese ruby proposition about forging iron on the hill is replaced by waiting for someone.

findings.highlight: Then the limit is somewhere beyond the darkness
findings.evidenceJa: その闇の先に、この身体の限度がある
findings.governingReading: beyond that darkness lies the limit or full extent of this body
findings.explanation: The discovery concerns Shirou’s bodily extent, but the English leaves the kind of limit unspecified.

findings.highlight: I have no regrets. This is the only path.
findings.evidenceJa: I have no regrets.This is the only path
findings.governingReading: then my life requires no meaning
findings.explanation: The active Japanese ruby proposition rejecting the need for life’s meaning disappears entirely.

findings.highlight: Magical energy ten times the capacity of the circuit breaks its foundations trying to escapeand I use a hundred circuits to take in a thousand times the capacity.
findings.evidenceJa: 一の回路に満ちた十の魔力は、その逃げ場を求めて基盤を壊し百の回路をもって、千の魔力を引き入れる
findings.governingReading: ten units of mana fill one circuit and break its foundation seeking escape; with a hundred circuits, he draws in a thousand units of mana
findings.explanation: The staged one–ten–hundred–thousand expansion is rewritten as two unsupported capacity ratios.

findings.highlight: trying to escapeand I use a hundred circuits
findings.evidenceJa: 逃げ場を求めて基盤を壊し百の回路
findings.governingReading: trying to escape, and with a hundred circuits
findings.explanation: Missing spacing fuses two major stages of the Reality Marble’s expansion.

findings.highlight: My whole life was ‘unlimited blade works’
findings.evidenceJa: My whole life was unlimited blade works
findings.governingReading: this body was made of infinite swords
findings.explanation: mirror moon preserves the English incantation but deletes the active Japanese ruby proposition identifying Shirou’s body.

findings.highlight: a gruesome expression
findings.evidenceJa: 鬼気迫る形相
findings.governingReading: an expression of fierce, almost demonic intensity
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s battle intensity becomes physical grotesqueness.

findings.highlight: nothing is here
findings.evidenceJa: おそらくは何もない
findings.governingReading: probably nothing is here
findings.explanation: The source’s qualification is removed from the Reality Marble’s paradox.

findings.highlight: Here I come, king of heroesdo you have enough weapons in stock?
findings.evidenceJa: いくぞ英雄王武器の貯蔵は十分か
findings.governingReading: Here I come, King of Heroes—do you have enough weapons in stock?
findings.explanation: Missing punctuation and spacing fuse the formal address to the challenge.

findings.highlight: Hahyou forget your place
findings.evidenceJa: は思い上がったな
findings.governingReading: Hah—you have grown presumptuous
findings.explanation: Missing punctuation fuses Gilgamesh’s laugh to the pronoun.

findings.highlight: readies numerous Noble Phantasms
findings.evidenceJa: 無数の宝具を展開する
findings.governingReading: deploys countless Noble Phantasms
findings.explanation: The visible mass deployment from the Gate is reduced to preparation.
